proposed.because: On the cmap tip, plain and italic Helvetica alphabet textLengths at 14 pt equal the recorded Java strings (ABCDEFGHIJKLM 117.4619, NOPQRSTUVWXYZ 129.1172), and bold equals Java too (121.3311 and 129.1172). c11a_of_comp_hv_b and c11a_of_part_hv_b are strict matches. The four c10a_ft_hv diagrams stay strict DIFF ndiff 33: the punctuation label is two Rust text nodes (256.6758 and 25.2861) against Java's one node (240.0166 plain, 248.2881 bold and bold-italic).

Mapped non-ASCII now uses the face cmap. c10a_st_usec_vd and c10a_st_part_vd are strict matches, and «Ferrous gauge vista» is textLength 157.2197 on both the Java SVG and the tip. «marker» on custom_class and custom_grouped_class is now 61.2366 (base was 58.2214) but both whole SVGs stay DIFF. m9a_vi_hebrew_italic stays DIFF ndiff 7 and byte-identical to the base: Java textLength 63.3145, tip 62.0156. Verdana italic does not map U+05D0, U+1D167 or U+05D1, so the fallback chain is unchanged. Arial italic does map U+05D0 and U+05D1.
